page.overview:
Who is Josh?

Josh is a InGen Hunter who appears as a minor character in The Lost World: Jurassic Park section of LEGO Jurassic World. He pretended to be a Velociraptor to trick his fellow hunter, Bob, during the raptors' attack in the Long Grass.

He and Bob later escaped together and managed to survive the attack, despite no hunters surviving in the film.
